title: The long spoon

item.name: The Long Spoon
item.line: An oak cooking spoon as long as an arm. The winner of the street's cook-off final gets a name burned into its handle.

brief: Tonight at 6 is the 20th cook-off final. The Long Spoon has 19 burns on its handle and 18 names. One was planed flat years ago, and nobody talks about it.
At 7 this morning the committee opened the cabinet in the hall store room to polish it. The cabinet was locked, and empty.
A card was left on the hooks, with a lantern drawn on it. The room smells faintly of burnt wood.
4 people were near the hall last night. Each has said where they were.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: Won the last 3 finals. Loses the spoon tonight if she loses.

suspects.name: Marco
suspects.line: Lost to Rosa by 1 vote last year. Says the count was wrong.
suspects.says: I was at my ovens. Bread does not wait.

suspects.name: Mr Cole
suspects.line: 22 years of keys. The store room is his.
suspects.says: I was at the gate. I saw nobody carry anything out.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: Has photographed the last 9 finals. Comes the night before with his lamps.
suspects.says: I set up my lamps and went home by 7.

steps.thing: The key book. Last night's page is torn across, and the blotter under it kept the wet ink back to front.
steps.text: .neetfif enin ta kcaB .sthgil eht rof ytrof xis ta tuo ,neves yeK
steps.fact: Key 7 went out at 6.40 pm "for the lights" and came back at 9.15 pm. The name was signed in pencil, on the torn half. Pencil does not blot.
steps.lead: Somebody had the store room for 2 hours and 35 minutes. Rosa has the most to lose tonight, and she says she was home by 7. Her till roll can say.

steps.thing: The till roll from last night. Every sale is on it, with its time.
steps.fact: She sold a plate every few minutes from 6.30 pm to 9.30 pm, 20 minutes' drive from the hall. She said home because the night stall has no permit.
steps.lead: Rosa has something to give back. Yesterday Marco told her whole queue that nobody would lift the spoon this year.

steps.thing: The invoice typewriter. Its ribbon kept every key Marco struck last night, in a row, with no spaces.
steps.fact: It is a petition: burn no name until last year's votes are counted again. The committee secretary signed for it at her door at 7 pm, 40 minutes from the hall.
steps.lead: One line of it stops you: "Count it right, or this is 2011 again." In 2011 a name was planed off the spoon. Mr Cole held the plane.

steps.thing: The gate book. On Friday nights the yard is a car park, and Mr Cole writes every car in.
steps.fact: He wrote in 31 cars between 6 pm and 10 pm and never left the gate. The cabinet key hangs with key 7, for the extension reels on the bottom shelf. Whoever took 7 had both.
steps.lead: Pressed in the back of the book is a curl of oak with burned letters: R. MARLOW. "They said she bought her stew base. Nobody proved it." And a notice went up on the hall board overnight.

steps.thing: A notice nobody remembers pinning up: a room to let, oddly worded. Read closely, it says something else.
steps.text: Room to let. Last let 2 years ago. Estate road, quiet. The light is on a meter. A tub, urn and stove are included. Ask Phoebe for entry.
steps.fact: Read word by word, it says: "Her name goes back before the 20th is burned. I have stood at 9 finals with my back to the crowd." It is signed "her son".
steps.lead: A key, a reel and 2 hours. A mother's name. 9 finals. They fit 1 of the 4.

steps.thing: The 4 from the brief, and what the evidence left standing.
steps.fact: Chance: key 7, from 6.40 pm to 9.15 pm. Means: the cabinet key, and a reel that fed more than lamps. Motive: a name planed off in 2011.

ending.found: The spoon is in Theo's lamp case, wrapped in a towel, with a soldering iron beside it. The planed patch is burned again: R. MARLOW 2011. The letters are less even than the rest.
ending.confession: I was 14 when they planed her off. She never bought that stew. I wanted it oiled and back on its hooks by 7, before anyone looked.
ending.after: The spoon is back on its hooks. The committee has until 6 to decide whether the 19th name stays. Mr Cole has not offered to fetch his plane.
